item.title: LIZ PEEK: Iran war could become the achievement that ensures Trump’s legacy
item.summary: Iran's Revolutionary Guard targeted Trump and Biden for assassination, but Democrats question our military response to Tehran's ongoing nuclear threats.

item.title: MORNING GLORY: The military needs money from Congress to finish off Iran
item.summary: Congress faces critical decision on military funding for Iran operations as Republicans explore reconciliation process to secure defense appropriations.

item.title: The war hits home: Why financial pain and economic uncertainty threaten Trump’s drive to topple Iran’s regime
item.summary: As the Pentagon continues churning out videos of bombs wreaking havoc in Iran, an important question arises: how high a price are Americans willing to pay for this war?

item.title: 21 Iranian women’s soccer players weigh return home after 5 granted asylum
item.summary: Australia granted asylum to five Iranian women's soccer players who sought safety while visiting for a tournament, although the fate of the rest of team remains uncertain.

item.title: Tyler Linderbaum's $81M record-breaking deal headlines Raiders' free agent spending spree
item.summary: The Raiders made Tyler Linderbaum the highest-paid interior lineman in league history with an $81M deal, as Las Vegas goes all-in during the NFL free agency tampering period.

item.title: All eyes on Georgia as Trump-backed candidate battles in high-stakes congressional showdown
item.summary: Georgia special election draws national attention as Trump-backed candidate Clay Fuller competes to fill Marjorie Taylor Greene's vacant House seat.

item.title: The Hitchhiker’s Guide to the 'talking filibuster' and the SAVE Act
item.summary: Republicans push to alter Senate filibuster rules to pass Trump's SAVE Act requiring citizenship proof for voting, despite significant procedural hurdles.

item.title: At least 40 percent of California teachers plan to quit in the next decade: survey
item.summary: Teacher shortage crisis affects California as 40% consider leaving education due to financial issues, while nationwide 35% of teachers plan to exit the profession in the next decade.

item.title: DHS shutdown forces airports to tell travelers to arrive 4 hours early amid massive delays
item.summary: The DHS shutdown is causing massive airport delays, with wait times reaching 3.5 hours at some major hubs. Officers work without pay as funding lapse continues.

item.title: JONATHAN TURLEY: Sanders' wealth tax dangles checks while torching the Constitution
item.summary: New billionaire wealth tax would fund $3,000 annual payments to families earning under $150k. Plan mirrors California's failed approach to wealth taxes.
